title.en: Fable 27 — The Milkmaid and Her Pail

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.ar: נערה הלכה לשוק עם דלי חלב.
sentences.en: A girl walked to the market with a pail of milk.
She carried it on her head.
She thought: I will buy eggs with the money.
She thought: from the eggs there will be chickens.
She thought: I will buy a new dress.
She danced a little from joy.
The pail fell and the milk spilled.
Do not count before you have it.
